prediction_before_run: Nominal wheel targets without wheel PI should undershoot the moving reference, consistent with previous wheel response checks.
Wheel PI should reduce persistent wheel-speed error, but without pose feedback it cannot correct the deliberate initial global position offset.
Estimated-pose feedback plus the same wheel PI is expected to reduce path error and end within 25 mm; actual metrics and every failed attempt will be retained.
All three runs use the same initial physical setup and PCG64 seed, but different controls create different trajectories and measured encoder variances. They are not identical-input estimator replays.
The final stop segment sends exact zero actuator targets and resets PI integral; stopping is evaluated from independent physical speed, not just the issued command.
parameter_basis: Positive nonlinear body-error feedback gains selected before physical trials; actuator limit from the fixed official model, desired wheel limit reserves control authority. Wheel PI addresses observed target/actual speed mismatch, using filtered noisy encoder increments only. No fitting to evaluation truth; formal kinematic stability argument excludes input saturation, actuator lag and estimation errors.
scope: State-feedback trajectory module with three physical mode comparisons, normal camera visibility. No LiDAR obstacle avoidance, charging-station terminal pose regulation, full-task success rate or new-environment validation.
